name: live_planner_llm
description: Verified-working live configuration: deterministic per-turn planner for combat, local LLM for out-of-combat decisions, Ironclad at ascension 0.

verified.what_was_verified: Planner drove two full combats against the running Steam client: multi-action turns (3-4 plays), real damage (9-17/turn), lethal taken when available, HP held at 79-80/80. No unrecognised card or monster ids.
verified.not_yet_verified: The LLM half has NOT been run live: Qwen3.6-27B Q3_K_M needs ~13GB and only ~4.4GB is free with the game running, so the two cannot coexist on this machine. LLM out-of-combat quality is measured in-sim only (13.12 +/- 1.52 floors, n=8).

game._note: Written by scripts/agent_config.py and scripts/who_plays.py into the deployed mod folder; read by RlAutoSlayer at character select.

objective_order: lethal -- kill every enemy, ending the combat
hp_preserved -- HP lost, measured AFTER the enemy turn resolves
setup -- POWER cards played, to scale later turns
combat._objective_note: Lexicographic, not weighted. No quantity of damage can outrank taking less HP loss, because the comparison never reaches the damage field unless HP loss ties. A weighted sum let ~1.5 damage 'pay for' 1 HP, which is what produced the reported under-blocking.
combat._beam_note: The beam is SPLIT: half ranked by proximity to lethal, half by the safety heuristic. Ranking mid-turn nodes by a single scalar pruned kill lines several plies before the kill landed, which is what produced the reported missed lethals.

out_of_combat._prefill_note: Qwen3.6 is a hybrid reasoner that ignores /no_think. Prefilling an ALREADY CLOSED think block is what took parse rate from 23% to ~99%: the block cannot be reopened, so generation starts at the answer.
out_of_combat._fallback_note: Unparseable replies fall back to the scripted knowledge policy and are COUNTED, never coerced to option 0 -- option 0 is often 'skip'.

launch.order_matters: Start the agent FIRST, then the game. The mod plays with RANDOM choices whenever no agent is connected ('[RlMap] No agent connected, selecting random node') and aborts the run after a 120s timeout.
healthy_log_lines: Combat turn N: planned K actions (obj lethal=.. hp=.. setup=.. dmg=..)
unhealthy_log_lines: Combat: falling back -- ... does not send ...  (mod build lacks pile/deck fields)
Combat: no planner plan and no fallback policy; ending turn.

rebuild_needed_for: RlCombatHandler.cs -- draw_pile/discard_pile/exhaust_pile/deck CONTENTS (counts alone cannot support planning)
mod_requirements.build: set DOTNET_ROOT=%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\dotnet and prepend it to PATH, then: dotnet build bridge_mod/STS2BridgeMod.csproj
_build_notes: The dotnet first on PATH ships runtimes only; SDK 9.0.316 is in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\dotnet.
Godot's headless --export-pack exits -1 even on success; judge by ': error ' lines and artifact timestamps, not exit code.
Deploy fails with MSB3027/MSB3021 while the game is running -- it holds the DLL. Those are copy errors, not compile errors.

known_gaps: Enemy AI move state is not sent, so plans beyond one enemy turn are partly guesswork -- this is why planning is per-turn.
draw_pile index 0 is ASSUMED to be the top of the pile; unverified. If plans diverge on the first draw, reverse it.
Card tier priors in the LLM prompt are Necrobinder-specific; Ironclad cards render without a tier.
The 'setup' objective term counts POWER cards only; other scaling plays are not recognised.
